metadata.case_name: WO SUI LEUNG v. LEUNG CHUN MAN

injuries.description: Radiographs showed that the plaintiff had sustained Garden Type III fracture neck of left femur.
source: Radiographs showed that the plaintiff had sustained Garden Type III fracture neck of left femur.

injuries.description: Avascular necrosis (AVN) of the left femoral head with degenerative joint changes.
source: bone scan revealed avascular necrosis (“AVN”) at the suparo-lateral aspect of the left femoral hand with degenerative changes.
X-ray of the left hip joint revealed solidly united fracture with femoral head avascular necrosis and degenerative joint changes.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the hip or thigh

injuries.body_part: left hand; right upper limb; right knee; left face
source: multiple abrasions over his left hand, right upper limb and right knee

injuries.description: Tender and hypertrophic scar over upper thigh.
source: They also found shortening of left thigh by 1 cm, tender and hypertrophic scar over upper thigh with restricted active movements of left hip joint.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified superficial injury of hip or thigh

injuries.description: Shortening of left thigh by 1 cm.
source: shortening of left thigh by 1 cm
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the hip or thigh

manifestations.description: Weakness and stiffness of left hip / left lower limb
Restricted active movement of left hip joint
Difficulty in climbing up stairs (need to hold rails or climb up stairs with stick)
Unable to stand on single leg or tiptoes
Have to change sitting posture every 30 minutes
Can only manage to walk with a stick
Restricted movement of left shoulder (plaintiff's claimed complaint; experts found not caused by the accident)
Pain, tenderness and crepitation of left shoulder joint (plaintiff's claimed complaint; experts found not caused by the accident)
Reduced strength of left shoulder and left upper limb (plaintiff's claimed complaint; experts found not caused by the accident)

treatments_received: closed reduction and screw fixation (emergency operation)
outpatient follow up at Princess Margaret Hospital Orthopaedic Specialist Clinic

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Cannot squat, run or jump. Social and recreational activities will be affected. He cannot take up most of the sports.
Cannot walk without a stick or a companion; walking tolerance limited to about 30 minutes; standing tolerance about 15 minutes.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Before the accident he helped in doing all household chores; now he only helps with non-strenuous household jobs.

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Seldom goes out as he was afraid of being knocked by others and because of difficulty in ambulation.
Tender and hypertrophic scar over upper thigh.

comparable_cases.case_name: Tam Mei Lin v Fung King Kong
comparable_cases.injury_description: Fracture of the neck of her femur; subsequently found to have suffered from AVN of the femoral head; hip replacement surgery was subsequently performed. Residual stiffness, limp and limited movement.

comparable_cases.case_name: Cheung Kwok Leung v Yip Man Hing Building Materials Co Ltd
comparable_cases.injury_description: Garden type IV comminuted fracture of the neck of femur; subsequent displacement and additional operations; diagnosed with AVN and early osteoarthropathy; articular collapse.
